title: Personal Research Assistant
summary: A personal project: a web app that answers research queries with AI, stores conversations and links the sources it used.
overview: A web-based research assistant. The frontend uses HTML, CSS and JavaScript; the backend is FastAPI with MongoDB for data persistence. Research responses include linked sources.
problem: Researching a topic means searching, reading and keeping track of sources. This project wraps AI-powered answers, source links and saved conversation history in one app.
approach: A /research endpoint returns AI-powered responses to research queries.
A /store_conversations endpoint saves and manages chat sessions in MongoDB.
Research responses include clickable citations that link to sources.

architecture.label: Frontend
architecture.detail: HTML, CSS and JavaScript, responsive for desktop and mobile.

architecture.label: Backend
architecture.detail: FastAPI with MongoDB for conversation storage and JWT authentication.

architecture.label: AI and search services
architecture.detail: The README lists Azure OpenAI and SerpAPI configuration. Exactly how search results feed the model is not described.

architecture.label: Retrieval method
architecture.detail: Not specified; this page does not claim a RAG pipeline.

workflow.step: A signed-in user submits a research query.
The /research endpoint returns an AI-generated answer with linked sources.

items: Built this personal project end to end (frontend, FastAPI backend and MongoDB storage), per the public repository.

limitations: Details come from the project's public README on GitHub; no usage numbers, accuracy figures or deployment results are claimed.
Personal project, not production client work.
